title: DSPy Retrieval Modules
summary: This module provides various retrieval components for DSPy programs, including a base interface for all retrievers, specialized ColBERTv2 implementations, and integrations with external vector databases like Databricks and Weaviate. It enables DSPy to fetch relevant passages from diverse data sources.

nodes.label: Base Retriever
nodes.title: DSPy Base Retriever Interface
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface and common properties for all retrieval modules within DSPy, enabling consistent interaction with various data sources.

nodes.label: Embeddings with Scores
nodes.title: Embeddings Retriever with Scores
nodes.description: Extends a standard embeddings retriever to also return similarity scores alongside retrieved passages and their indices, facilitating advanced ranking and filtering.

nodes.label: Databricks Vector Search
nodes.title: Databricks Vector Search Retriever
nodes.description: Integrates DSPy with Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search Index, allowing retrieval of relevant documents from Databricks based on a query.

nodes.label: Weaviate Vector DB
nodes.title: Weaviate Vector Database Retriever
nodes.description: Provides an interface for DSPy programs to query a Weaviate vector database, fetching top passages matching a given input query.

nodes.label: Local ColBERTv2 Indexer
nodes.title: Local ColBERTv2 Index & Search
nodes.description: Manages a local ColBERTv2 index, allowing for the building of an index from passages and subsequent efficient retrieval of relevant documents.

nodes.label: Local ColBERTv2 Reranker
nodes.title: Local ColBERTv2 Passage Reranker
nodes.description: Utilizes ColBERTv2 locally to re-rank a set of passages based on their relevance to a given query, improving retrieval quality.

nodes.label: Remote ColBERTv2 Client
nodes.title: Remote ColBERTv2 Service Client
nodes.description: Connects to and queries a remote ColBERTv2 retrieval service via HTTP, abstracting the network communication for users.

nodes.label: ColBERTv2 GET API
nodes.title: ColBERTv2 GET Request Wrapper
nodes.description: A utility function that wraps HTTP GET requests for interacting with a ColBERTv2 API endpoint.

nodes.label: ColBERTv2 POST API
nodes.title: ColBERTv2 POST Request Wrapper
nodes.description: A utility function that wraps HTTP POST requests for interacting with a ColBERTv2 API endpoint.

nodes.label: Format Retrieved Passages
nodes.title: Passage Formatting Utility
nodes.description: Transforms raw passage data, typically from a retriever, into a standardized dspy.Prediction object for consistent output.

nodes.label: Databricks SDK
nodes.title: Databricks Python SDK
nodes.description: The official Python library for programmatic interaction with Databricks services, including Vector Search.

nodes.label: Weaviate Client
nodes.title: Weaviate Python Client
nodes.description: The Python client library used to connect to and perform operations on a Weaviate vector database instance.

nodes.label: ColBERT-AI Library
nodes.title: ColBERT-AI Python Library
nodes.description: The core Python library providing ColBERTv2 functionalities for dense retrieval, including indexing and searching.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction Output
nodes.description: A fundamental DSPy data structure used to encapsulate and standardize the outputs of DSPy modules, including retrieved passages.

groups.label: Base Retriever Abstractions
groups.title: Core Retriever Interfaces
groups.description: Contains the foundational interface that all DSPy retrieval modules adhere to, ensuring consistent behavior.

groups.label: Specialized Retriever Features
groups.title: Enhanced Retrieval Capabilities
groups.description: Modules offering specialized retrieval functionalities, such as returning similarity scores alongside passages.

groups.label: ColBERTv2 Integrations
groups.title: ColBERTv2 Retrieval & Reranking
groups.description: Components for integrating ColBERTv2, supporting both local indexing/reranking and remote API access for dense retrieval.

groups.label: Vector Database Integrations
groups.title: External Vector DB Connectors
groups.description: Connectors for popular external vector databases, enabling DSPy programs to leverage existing data stores for retrieval.

groups.label: Result Formatting
groups.title: Passage Output Standardization
groups.description: Utility functions dedicated to transforming raw retrieval results into DSPy's standardized Prediction object format.
